scripts.dev: node -e 'const { spawn } = require("child_process"); const api = spawn("npm", ["--prefix", "api", "run", "dev"], { stdio: "inherit" }); const web = spawn("npm", ["--prefix", "web", "run", "dev"], { stdio: "inherit" }); process.on("SIGINT", () => { api.kill(); web.kill(); process.exit(); });'
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
